CLIFF ROAD ABOVE THE BOWL BAY: a coast road hugging a candy-striped cliff, curving from the near foreground around a bay shaped like a bowl, turquoise shallows below, a stubby white lighthouse on the far point where the road vanishes

CAUSEWAY ACROSS THE JADE LAGOON: a flat straight causeway running from the near shore across a shallow jade lagoon to a distant rounded headland, the water glassy on both sides, a stone arch bridge lifting the road over a tidal channel at mid-distance

CLIFF CORNICHE ABOVE THE CRESCENT: a narrow coast road carved into a striped ochre cliff, sweeping from the near foreground in a long crescent curve above a scalloped bay, a pier with a lantern post jutting into the water at the far end

COAST ROAD OVER THE SEA STACK POINT: a road running along a chalk-white cliff top from the near edge, rounding a broad headland above a curved cove, a village of round-roofed houses clustered at the point where the road bends away and vanishes

SWITCHBACKS UP THE LOAF MOUNTAIN: a road stacking up a rounded mountainside in five tight hairpins, meadows between the bends, a tiny stone hut with a bell at the top where the road crests, a valley of patchwork fields spread far below

HAIRPIN PASS BETWEEN THE SUGAR PEAKS: a road climbing from a green valley floor through six stacked switchbacks between two rounded snow-capped peaks, a stone tunnel mouth with a heavy keystone framing the vanishing point at the high col

SPIRAL ROAD UP THE STRIPED DOME: a road coiling up a dome-shaped mountain banded in candy-striped rock, each loop tighter than the last, a windmill with four fat sails standing just below the rounded summit where the road disappears

SWITCHBACKS TO THE HIGH MEADOW: a mountain road stacking four broad hairpins up a rounded green slope, each bend wider than a cartwheel, a castle with a single round tower sitting on the crest where the road vanishes into the upper plateau

TRESTLE ACROSS THE GORGE: a tall wooden trestle bridge striding across a deep green gorge on stilt legs, the track running from the near bank to a tunnel mouth in the far cliff, a waterfall threading the gorge floor below

STONE VIADUCT ACROSS THE ROUND VALLEY: a rail line crossing a valley on a viaduct of twelve round stone arches, the track curving from the near cutting to a far hillside station, a covered bridge carrying a farm lane beneath the central arch

LAKESHORE TRACK AROUND THE MIRROR LAKE: a rail line curving from the near platform along the shore of a long oval lake, hugging the water's edge as it rounds the far headland and vanishes, a tiny station house with a bell at the near end

TERRACED HILL TRACK: a rail line winding up through five stacked terraces of striped hillside, the track switchbacking between stone retaining walls from the valley floor to a high ridge, a giant mushroom-capped tree shading the uppermost terrace

RIDGE ROAD ALONG THE CUSHION HILLS: a road running along the spine of a chain of rounded hills stacked like cushions, rising and dipping from the near crest to a far horizon, a castle with a single round tower on the highest hill at mid-distance

HIGH MOOR ROAD TO THE CAIRN: a straight road crossing a broad rounded moor, running from the near edge to a tall stone cairn on the skyline, peat-brown heath on both sides, a stone arch bridge over a dark stream at mid-distance

RIDGE ROAD OVER THE LOAF BACKS: a road tracing the spine of a long loaf-shaped ridge, dipping gently from the near summit through three saddles to a far rounded peak, a windmill with four fat sails standing on the second saddle

COBBLED LANE UP THE PASTEL TOWN: a steep cobbled lane climbing between tall narrow houses painted in soft pastel colours, rising from the near archway through four tight bends to a bell tower at the top where the lane vanishes, window boxes lining every sill

TRAM TRACK UP THE GARDEN HILL: a tram track climbing a hill between gardens of topiary spheres and low stone walls, running from the near plaza through three curves to a round-roofed terminus at the crest, a covered bridge arching over the track at mid-climb

STEPPED LANE TO THE TOWER GATE: a steep cobbled lane rising from the near square between narrow houses with rounded tile roofs, curving twice and climbing to a stone arch gate at the summit where the lane passes through and vanishes, a lantern post at the gate

RIVER BENDING THROUGH THE GREEN VALLEY: a broad river making two wide bends through a valley of green meadows, a calm lane of water running from the near bank through the first bend and then the second to a distant covered bridge where it curves away

LONG LAKE LANDING LANE: a long narrow lake stretching from the near dock straight to a far wooded shore, the calm water surface acting as a lane of reflection, a pier with a lantern post standing at the near end above the still surface

FJORD BETWEEN THE GREEN WALLS: a deep fjord running from a wide mouth at the near foreground straight between two rounded green walls of hillside to a distant head where the water ends, a stone arch bridge spanning the fjord at the narrowest point

FARM ROAD THROUGH THE PATCHWORK VALLEY: a straight farm road running from the near gate through a valley of patchwork fields divided by dark hedgerows, vanishing at a gentle ridge on the far side, a stone arch bridge carrying the road over a stream at mid-distance

GRASS RUNWAY ACROSS THE QUILTED PLAIN: a grass runway running from the near windsock through a rolling quilt of differently coloured fields, the strip straight and pale green, a tiny station house with a bell beside the far threshold where the runway ends

SNOWY RIDGE TRACK ABOVE THE FROZEN LAKE: a track running along a snowy ridge from the near snowfield above a frozen oval lake far below, curving to a rounded summit on the horizon, a stone cairn with a flag standing at the highest point of the ridge

SAND TRACK BETWEEN THE DUNES TO THE OASIS: a pale sand track winding between rounded amber dunes from the near crest through two broad curves to a circular oasis of dark palms in the far hollow, a stone arch bridge carrying the track over a dry gully at mid-distance
